title: SPPI by Division (2 digits)
description: Services producer price index (SPPI) by MSIC division (2 digits).

fields.name: series
fields.title: Series Type
fields.description: [String] Series type, either absolute values ('abs'), year-on-year growth ('growth_yoy') or quarter-on-quarter growth ('growth_qoq')

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format. The earliest date in the quarter is chosen, e.g. YYYY-01-01 for the 1st quarter and YYYY-04-01 for the 2nd quarter.

fields.name: division
fields.title: Division
fields.description: [String] 2-digit code, to be matched using the 'division' column in the [MSIC Lookup](https://open.dosm.gov.my/data-catalogue/msic). The MSIC lookup table will give you the English and Malay definitions.

fields.name: index
fields.title: Index
fields.description: [Float] Level of services producer prices, expressed as an index with base 2010 = 100

methodology: The Services Producer Price Index (SPPI) measures the level of prices charged by 8 key services industries in Malaysia, relative to a base year (2010 = 100). Given that the services sector accounts for over 50% of Malaysia's GDP, the SPPI is an important policy indicator which helps gauge cost pressures before they reach consumers. The prices used in compilation of the SPPI include surcharges, but exclude discounts, rebates and taxes imposed on consumers. For a deeper understanding of the PPI compilation methodology and related concepts, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/sppi).
caveat: Data for the most recent 4 quarters may be revised in subsequent releases.
publication: [Services Producer Price Index, 1Q 2026](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/sppi_2026-q1), the latest edition of the monthly producer price statistics published by DOSM. OpenDOSM also features a [dashboard on services producer prices](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/services-producer-prices) where you can explore this data in a more interactive manner.
